description: This source file provides utilities for aligning and correcting subtitle entries in a subtitle synchronization system, using transcript data (such as from Whisper) as reference. It includes functions to normalize text, enforce timing constraints, match subtitles with transcript segments, and refine subtitle timing and text alignment.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if the provided text is None or consists only of whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in the provided text by collapsing multiple spaces and trimming.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the overlap duration between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Computes the center point of a time interval.

methods.name: float _safe_time(t: float)
methods.description: Ensures the time value is not negative; clamps to zero if negative.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle timings in-place to ensure sequential, non-overlapping, and minimal spacing.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment that best matches a subtitle interval based on overlap and center proximity.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment whose center is closest to a given point in time.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank subtitles to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Sets subtitle text from a transcript segment if it is missing or to normalize spacing.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Refines subtitle start and end times to better match the transcript segment, maintaining minimal and realistic durations.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles(transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict])
methods.description: Main function to align and correct subtitles using a transcript, normalizing text, matching segments, adjusting timings, and ensuring overall consistency.

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/
